cards.title: Moon Muffin Tray Wobble
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a cozy reading nook table where a paper market scene needs one clear reason before anything changes: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the paper card beside a pretend page, a paper bookmark, and one blank cover shape, then point to the moon muffin tray clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Read the tiny market moment, choose the one clear cause, and write it in the lamp glow space: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: What made the moon muffin tray wobble at the paper counter: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What happened right after the tray wobbled: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The tray wobbled because ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The tray wobbled, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Link the first cause to the next tiny market event: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back to the pretend page and circle the clue that proves your cause: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: whisper the cause to the adult leader, then write only the key words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: use the same moon muffin cause with a new paper-card effect: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Envelope Plop
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a cushion corner where writers name the direct effect of one invented puddle-planet cause: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set out the card with a pretend page, paper envelope shape, and lamp glow marker, then read the puddle clue aloud: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Look at the cause on the paper card and write the direct effect that would happen next: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: the puddle stamp slid off the envelope shape; add one detail that explains why: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What direct effect happens when the puddle stamp slides away: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The stamp slid away because ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The puddle stamp slid away, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Make a short chain from stamp slip to envelope change: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back to the paper clue and tell which effect matches it best: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to the direct effect first, then copy it into the blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: draw a new envelope shape and give it one direct effect: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Pause
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a reading nook rail scene where writers build one clear because statement with invented page labels only: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the card near a blank cover shape and a paper bookmark, then invite the writer to notice the train pause clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a full because statement that connects the train pause to one invented cause: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: What caused the Buttonwood Library Train to pause by the cushion shelf: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What changed in the quiet rail scene after the train paused: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The Buttonwood Library Train paused because ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The train paused, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Add one more linked step after the pause: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check your because statement against the pretend page clue and fix one word if needed: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: say the because statement softly, then write the final version: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: make another rail-scene because statement on a fresh paper card: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Paper Map Mixup
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a cozy paper bakery scene where writers turn one map mixup into a clear so result: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Lay the card beside a pretend page and a tiny paper path map, then mark the button bakery mixup clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Read the cause, then write the result that begins after the word so: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: What caused the button bakery paper path map to turn the wrong way: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What changed at the paper counter after the map turned the wrong way: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The path map turned the wrong way because ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The path map turned the wrong way, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Add one more result after your so sentence: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back to the blank cover shape scene and underline the result clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose the so result from two adult-read choices, then write it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: reuse the paper path map with a new so result: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Weather Window
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a lamp glow nook where writers show how an invented setting changes what happens: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set the card near a pretend page and choose one paper weather window setting before the writer adds the effect: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Name the setting first, then tell what effect it has on the Teacup Town scene: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: What setting detail appears in the Teacup Town weather window: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What effect does that setting have on the paper teacup cart or cushion corner: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The scene changed because the weather window showed ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The weather window changed the setting, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Connect setting to action to final nook detail: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back to the pretend page and make sure the effect fits the setting: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to the setting picture, then write only the effect words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: try a different paper weather window and write its effect: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice Board Chain
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for a paper-only reading nook park where writers link three invented events in order: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the fictional notice board card beside a paper bookmark and blank cover shape, then model one cause leading to one effect: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a cause, its effect, and the next effect so the pocket park chain makes sense: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: What first cause appears on the pocket park notice board slip: ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: What effect happens right after that first cause: ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Finish the sentence: The pocket park changed because ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: Finish the sentence: The first notice slip changed, so ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Build the chain: first cause, first effect, next effect: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back to the pretend page and make sure each link follows from the one before it: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: tap each paper link in order before writing the chain: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: fold a fresh paper card and make a new three-link chain: ____________________.
